name: Suidooster
description: Suidooster is a South African television soap opera produced by Suidooster Films which revolves around a matriarch, her family, friends and the people of Suidooster, a small shopping and business centre in the fictional Cape Town suburb of Ruiterbosch.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Three families live and work together and consequently share in each other’s joys and sorrows. The Octobers are planning a birthday party, the Samsodiens are considering going on holiday and the Du Plooys are at loggerheads with each other.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Mrs Jacobs goes out of her way to track down her lost daughter, disturbing Bridgette in the process. The mysterious Bianca hides a secret from the people of Suidooster, while Mymoena wants to start her own business. In the Du Plooy household, the standoff between father Chris and his son Tim reaches crisis point when Chris takes action.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Bianca starts her job as a waitress at Oos Wes, but should the people of Suidooster trust her? Against his father’s wishes, Tim accepts his new job offer and looks forward to getting to know his boss’s daughter better. Mrs Jacobs’s 70th birthday bash is in full swing when a guest arrives who can derail the whole event.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Mrs J is desperate to find her lost daughter’s phone number, while Bridgette is convinced Ian summoned her sister back. Stefan feels he’s competing with Mymoena’s samoosas, until AB puts his foot down regarding this matter. Tim is crestfallen when Ian gives him his first job and Bianca is forced to confide in Michelle.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Mrs J is desperate for her daughters to reconcile but Bridgette doesn’t trust Lee-Ann at all. Mymoena is excited about all the orders for her samoosas, while Nicole starts looking at Tim through new eyes. Meanwhile Stefan is still trying to catch the till thief in Oos Wes.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Jerome decides to step in when he sees how much the rift between her daughters is upsetting Mrs J. Nicole tries to help Tim at work but things don’t work out the way she intended. Bianca and Mymoena are getting a business plan together when AB walks in on them. Is this the end of Mymoena’s dream to be a little more independent?

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Mrs J wants to know why Bianca lied to them but is unsure whether she can believe her daughter’s explanation. Jerome tells Tim that he’s wasting his time with Nicole, while still trying to outdo Rhafiek when it comes to Bianca. Lee-Ann asks Ian for help and Bianca manages to convince Michelle that Mymoena is indeed her mother.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Mymoena is becoming suspicious oft Bianca’s motives behind helping her, while Bianca and Rhafiek are getting along like a house on fire. At the office, Tim tries to prove himself to Ian once again and later he surprises Nicole when she sees how much he cares for others. Meanwhile Bridgette asks Chris to do her dirty work and Mrs J gets an unexpected surprise.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Lee-Ann is living with her mother again after years of absence, but how long will this new-found peace last? Bianca gets cold feet regarding her plan to confront her biological mother. Tim’s new job is proving to be a more difficult challenge than he expected, and not for reasons he could have foreseen.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Rhafiek and Bianca are getting on extremely well, which makes Stefan and Michelle very uneasy. Mrs J wants Lee-Anne to get involved with Suidooster, while Chris worries that she can put a stop to the plans he and Ian are hatching. Bianca tries to withdraw from the samoosa business, fearing that Mymoena might find out about her secret.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Lee-Ann finds out that Ian is not very popular among the tenants at the Suidooster Centre. Stefan believes that he has found a perfect way to lure more customers to Oos Wes. Mymoena and Bianca are both in a state after the truth comes out.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Lee-Ann is making progress; Bridgette seems almost ready to make peace, or is it too early to tell? Tim’s chances with Nicole seem non-existent, while Jerome comes up with a clever plan to guide Fasie through his first date with a lady. Bianca cancels her dinner date with Rhafiek and his whole world crumbles when he learns why.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Rhafiek is in a state after finding out that Mymoena is Bianca’s biological mother. Lee-Ann firmly puts Ian in his place, while Michelle curries favour with Stefan. Bridgette makes her peace with Mrs J and once again visits her husband at the office...

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: In the Samsodien household the tension between Mymoena and her son reaches breaking point. Bridgette becomes suspicious about Ian’s plans for the centre when Mrs J alerts her to the fact that he made her an offer for her shares as well.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Bridgette confronts Ian about preferring Lee-Ann above her as a business partner. A stressed Rhafiek is rude to Nicole and Tim takes him to task. Maymoena asks Bianca to leave so that she won’t lose her husband and two sons. Bridgette and Lee-Ann have a fight about the past which leads to a shocking revelation.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Lee-Ann needs to process the shocking revelation that she might not have been responsible for her father’s death all those years ago. Bianca refuses to be chased away and decides to reveal to AB that his wife is her biological mother. Tim takes his battle for Nicole’s favour to the next level.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Chris is sent to Mrs J’s house under the pretext that he has to fix something, but this is just a ruse of Ian’s. Michelle buys more baby clothes and has to lie about it again. Nicole and Lee-Ann are excited about their plans for Suidooster Centre and Mrs J drops a bomb that catches Ian completely by surprise.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Lee-Ann plans a Christmas dinner, almost ruining Bridgette’s annual Christmas party for the people of the centre, while Mrs J becomes suspicious of Lee-Ann and Ian’s meetings. Stefan surprises Michelle, but all she really wants is a baby.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: The new-found peace between the October sisters disintegrates when Mrs J appoints a new manager for the Suidooster strip mall. To Tim’s great annoyance Nicole decides to be proactive and get closer to Rhafiek. Michelle admits she desperately wants to start a family, but Stefan feels the opposite.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: AB is shocked when he sees Bianca and Rhafiek together and then finds out that Mymoena knew that they were still in contact. Tim tries to date Nicole again, while a cold war is raging between Stefan and Michelle. Lee-Ann gets hold of Suidooster’s books and is concerned about what she discovers.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Nicole thinks that Rhafiek chose Bianca above her, and AB is against what he perceives as Rhafiek and Bianca’s relationship. Michelle’s longing for a child puts more pressure on her and Stefan’s marriage.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Michelle’s advice to Tim begins to pay off as Nicole finally seems to take notice of him. Bridgette discovers that Lee-Ann is getting cosy at Ian’s office and leaves her own mark on Suidooster Properties. Mymoena’s secret reaches its expiry date and AB insists on knowing the truth.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: The Samsodiens find themselves in a lose-lose situation, while Michelle and Stefan’s relationship reaches an all-time low over the baby issue. Ian spins a story to explain what he did with the centre’s money, and Mrs J has problems with her car. Meanwhile Nicole is in two minds about Rhafiek and Tim.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Mrs J starts to forget small everday things and Bridgette is concerned that this could be the start of Alzheimer’s. Fasie makes a date on the Internet, while Stefan tries to patch up things with Michelle. Bianca and Rhafiek try to dissuade Mymoena from telling AB the truth about her youth but she feels it’s now or never.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: The secret is out, and AB struggles to accept that Bianca is in fact Mymoena’s daughter. Nicole agrees to go on a date with Tim, but he realises he doesn’t have the slightest clue where to take her. Bridgette wants to start working at Suidooster Properties again so that she can assist Jerome but he is wrestling with his own secret.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Ian shares some good news about their plans for the centre with Chris. Bridgette is suddenly unsure whether she should go and work at Suidooster Properties again. Rhafiek tries to convince his father to support Mymoena, but AB wants nothing to do with her.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Bridgette decides against Ian’s wishes to help Jerome with his work at Suidooster Properties. AB can’t forgive Mymoena and insists that Rhafiek contacts his brother in London to inform him of the situation at home. Michelle tries to make plans to boost her and Stefan’s finances, while Tim and Nicole’s relationship is flourishing.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Michelle and Stefan join forces to try and overcome their problems. Mrs J becomes even more forgetful and considers moving to an old age home. AB confronts Bianca, and Ian finally tells Lee-Ann where all of Suidooster’s money went to.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Tim and Nicole are finding it difficult to hide their infatuation, especially when Jerome becomes suspicious. Lee-Ann is not convinced of Ian’s stories about where Suidooster’s money has gone and decides to investigate. Bianca wrestles with AB’s request that she needs to get out of the Samsodiens’ lives.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Ian plays a dirty trick on Mrs J to show that she’s no longer of sound mind. Nicole tells Rhafiek that she and Tim are together. Mymoena spends the entire day in search of Bianca but no one has seen her. Michelle and Stefan take the first step to get out of their financial predicament.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Lee-Ann accepts that Mrs J’s memory is deteriorating, and Chris feels guilty about them putting an old lady through such torture. Jerome gets on Bridgette’s bad side, while Michelle still stresses about her and Stefan’s finances. Bianca tries to get through to AB but to no avail...

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Mymoena wants to mend things with AB while Bianca wants to get closer to her, but reconciliation is easier said than done. Bridgette presents Jerome with a job opportunity, and Tim and Nicole’s relationship heats up. Jerome interferes with Fasie’s dating life, while Lee-Ann tries to warn Chris against Ian.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Rhafiek gives his father a piece of his mind, and things seem to improve between AB and Mymoena. Jerome’s new boss makes his life difficult and Nicole disappoints her father. Michelle struggles to get her risqué party going, and Ian plots and schemes with Chris, little knowing that Lee-Ann is hot on his tracks.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: AB tries hard to digest the Bianca situation, but feels Rhihaaz has a right to know the truth, even if he’s in London. On the romantic front, things are looking up for Fasie, and Nicole and Tim are still head over heels in love.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Chris gives Ian Mrs J’s ID document and they continue plotting against her. Fasie finds out that Bianca is Mymoena’s daughter, and Stefan is worried about Michelle who misses her family terribly. Bridgette tells Ian about Nicole’s relationship with Tim and wants Delia to put a stop to it.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Mathilda doesn’t know what to make of Fasie and Mrs J’s friendship. Nicole finally gets the chance to prove herself, but must choose between work and her date with Tim. Chris identifies a neurologist that Ian can blackmail, but will they convince the good doctor to play along?

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Everyone is worried about Mrs J but she suspects that someone is behind her sudden “forgetfulness”. Michelle is desperate to watch rugby with the guys, while Bianca wants to find a way that she and Rhafiek can help their mother and AB. Nicci struggles to balance work and her love life, while Jerome sets up a hot date for Fasie.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Bridgette tries to manipulate the situation between her children in order to get her son interested in the family business. Ian plots to get Mrs J out of the picture, but Lee-Ann is getting closer to the truth and has some plans of her own.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Bridgette is unhappy about Nicole and Tim’s relationship, but Nicole couldn’t care less and their love flourishes. Ian’s tricks to make Mrs J doubt herself gather momentum. AB and Mymoena have to make a final decision about their future together or apart.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: Big changes take place in the Samsodien household after AB’s far-reaching decision. Stefan and Michelle could be in for a very big Valentine’s gift. Mrs J and her daughters finally visit her GP.

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: Mrs J gets her test results back from the GP. Nicole takes on her mother about how she’s treating Tim. Chris receives disturbing news about his wife, Rita.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Michelle is ready to do the pregnancy test but needs Bianca’s support. Chris and Lee-Ann get a little closer and she tries to find out more about his wife. Tim isn’t really looking forward to this evening’s dinner date with the Octobers.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: Mymoena misses AB, who is struggling to adapt to a bachelor’s life. Mrs J decides to take things easy, while Lee-Ann helps Bridgette to work on her relationship with her children. Michelle is still looking for the right moment to tell Stefan that she is pregnant.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: Chris has no idea how he will care for his wife when she’s discharged from the institution, but refuses to do Ian any more devious favours. Michelle still can’t find the right opportunity to tell Stefan she is pregnant, while Ian devises a new plan to drive the recently reconciled Bridgette and Lee-Ann apart.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: Bridgette is suspicious about what happened between Lee-Ann and Ian in his office, and she confronts both of them. Michelle tries to patch things up between Mymoena and AB, while Tim wants to figure out what Bridgette has against him. Michelle wonders if it’s the right time to let Stefan in on her big secret...

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: Mrs J disappears just before her appointment with the neurologist. Nicole and Jerome have to do their pitch without Bridgette. Rhafiek is angry with his parents and Ian warns Lee-Ann against Chris.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: Tim is worried about his dad earning less money now, while Nicole begs her mom to give Tim another chance. Rhafiek once again tries to talk to both his parents and Michelle is determined to keep her baby news private for while longer. In the meantime, Mrs J is waiting for her test results from the neurologist...

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: Mrs J and the entire family need to come to terms with the neurologist’s diagnosis, while Chris struggles not to spill the beans about the truth behind this. Michelle is livid with Stefan for apparently telling the entire world she’s pregnant. Tension builds between Chris and Tim, as Tim believes his mother is not yet ready to leave the sanatorium.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: Nicole and Jerome receive news regarding their pitch for Mr Harris. The Samsodiens are all at odds with each other. Chris makes a decision about Lee-Ann and Mrs J reveals who holds power of attorney for the centre.

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: Mymoena goes for a job interview, and Nicole confronts her mother about Tim again. Stefan is stressed about Michelle’s pregnancy, while Lee-Ann and Bridgette have a nasty argument.

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: Ian informs Bridgette about his plans for the Suidooster centre. Mymoena and Rhafiek have another argument about AB, and she decides to take action. Tim opens up to Nicci about his mother, while Stefan tries to explain his feelings about the pregnancy to Michelle.

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: Rita is back home, bringing a host of complications for the Du Plooys as they try to restore their family. Mymoena seeks to convince Rhafiek to intervene between her and AB, while Stefan realises that Michelle needs his support for the baby. After having found out about Ian’s plans for the centre, Lee-Ann is on the warpath...

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: Jerome and Rhafiek are missing. When they return, the reason for their disappearance catches everybody off guard - including themselves. Chris and Tim are trying their best to adapt with Rita back in the house, but not everybody is convinced that things will keep going well. Ian takes some desperate measures to execute his plans.

videos.title: Episode 54
videos.overview: Nicole meets Rita unexpectedly and AB doesn’t feel like the intervention at all. Ian’s plans with Lee-Ann boomerang, as she has some of her own tricks up her sleeve.

videos.title: Episode 55
videos.overview: AB moves back home but on certain conditions. Ian convinces Chris to work for him again, while Bridgette pays Rita a visit. Rhafiek apologises for having been so rude to Nicole, and Tim asks her understanding for the fact that his mom comes first for the time being.

videos.title: Episode 56
videos.overview: Mymoena struggles to pretend that all is forgiven and forgotten between her and AB. Lee-Ann asks AB and Fasie not to confront Ian again about his plans for Suidooster and to leave him to her. Stefan and Michelle are still at loggerheads about their future but then something finally pushes him to make a decision.

videos.title: Episode 57
videos.overview: Chris resorts to drastic measures to protect his loved ones against Ian. Michelle’s haste to move to Pretoria only pushes Stefan further away from her. Rita tells Nicci how tough it is, knowing that her family expects her to suffer a relapse at any moment.

videos.title: Episode 58
videos.overview: Lee-Ann tries to convince Bridgette to vote against Ian in his bid to sell the centre. Chris and Tim start noticing signs of Rita struggling to cope with her affliction. Mrs J seeks a second opinion to find out whether she does in fact have dementia.

videos.title: Episode 59
videos.overview: Bridgette has found out about Ian’s manipulation of Mrs J’s health issues, but does she have the courage and willpower to tell the rest of the family? Rita despises the way her medication inhibits her creativity, while she and Michelle are forming a strong bond.

videos.title: Episode 60
videos.overview: Jerome continues his speed-dating night without Fasie’s permission. AB refuses to go away with Mymoena for the weekend, but she continues with her plans. Everyone anxiously awaits Mrs J’s second test resuts.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Bridgette demands that Ian tears up the contract giving him power of attorney over her mother’s shares, or she will tell Mrs J the truth about the neurologist who misdiagnosed her.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Jerome and Carmen try to work out where they stand with each other. Stefan and Michelle dream about their baby while Nicci realises hom much she cares for Tim. Chris tries to explain to Rita that he and Lee-Ann are merely friends.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Carmen meets the Octobers and Ian immediately takes a liking to her. Stefan is worried about Michelle, while Chris has to choose between Rita’s mental health and Lee-Ann’s friendship. Mrs J decides to whom she is going to assign the power of attorney over her shares in Suidooster.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Bridgette puts her foot down about Jerome’s relationship with Carmen, and gets more involved in the centre’s business affairs.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Chris and Tim do their best to ensure that Rita takes her medicine, but she conjures up new lies to avoid taking it.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Chris discovers Rita missed her doctor’s appointment and blames Tim for it. Michelle has another bout of cramps, while Bianca finds out that Carmen and Jerome are married. The charming Harry Galant meets Lee-Ann and Bridgette.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Ian and Bridgette are furious with Jerome and insist that he has the marriage annulled. The Samsodiens are shocked when they find out what happened to Debbie. Harry has a meeting with the Jacobs sisters, while Nicole and Tim have a serious discussion about the future of their relationship.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Michelle blames herself for the miscarriage and AB wants to win Mymoena back, but isn’t sure how to go about it. Rita’s mental health detriorates, forcing Chris to consider other arrangements. Another incident at the centre complicates matters for Lee-Ann when she gets a journalist to write an article about Suidooster.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Lee-Ann and Bridgette need to calm down the tenants when the crime wave spins out of control. Panic sets in when AB can’t get hold of Mymoena after a big highway accident, while Ian has new information that puts Jerome’s relationship with Carmen in jeopardy.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Rita’s disappearance has Chris and Tim in a state of panic, and Nicole does everything she can to help them. Ian and Harry’s scheming regarding crime and safety at the centre gathers momentum. Michelle struggles to process her miscarriage and takes her frustrations out on Stefan.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Bridgette is upset that Nicole is helping Tim look for Rita. Peace has finally returned to the Samsodien household. Carmen has all sorts of plans, and Rhafiek almost tells Nicole how he feels about her. Chris and Tim reach breaking point: there’s still no sign of Rita.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Tim lashes out at Lee-Ann when she arrives at the Du Plooy home to support Chris. AB informs Rhafiek that he invited Bianca and Carmen for dinner and asks for his help. There’s big drama at the deli and someone gets hurt...

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Mymoena has a suggestion for Stefan and Michelle concerning her miscarriage and Mrs J decides on the future of the centre after the holdup in the deli.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Chris wants to find out if Ian is behind the crimewave that hit the centre, while Tim tries to reach out to Nicole again.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Stefan berates himself for not having defended himself during the robbery. Rhafiek needs to accept that Nicole has no intention of breaking up with Tim. Rita tries to explain that she knows who is responsible for the crime wave in Suidooster. Both Lee-Ann and Ian take her seriously...

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Harry gives Ian until evening to find himself the things he needs to get into the chemist. Rita begs Chris not to send her back to the sanatorium and to rather let her live on the streets. Tim asks Nicci to make him a promise...

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Stefan tries his best to lift spirits at home. Carmen’s long-awaited treasure chest finally arrives, and something she finds inside makes her sad. A hostage drama is taking place in the October living room.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: The hostage drama in the October household continues. Stefan is excited about his first martial arts class, while Tim is devastated after his phone conversation with Nicci. Chris fears for Ian and his family’s lives and is forced to ask Lee-Ann for help.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: The hostage drama at the October home continues and Ian tries to free his family. The Samsodiens are rocked by tragedy. Carmen finds herself in a struggle between the past and the present.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Tim needs advice from Chris regarding an important decision. The Octobers try to move on after their traumatic ordeal. Nicole is still uncomfortable with Shahieda and Rhafiek seeing each other.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Rhafiek tries to find a way to cope with his feelings about Tim and Nicole’s relationship. Fasie wants to reconcile with Mathilda, but finds it difficult to win back her trust. Ian gives Bridgette a gift and makes her a promise... but can she trust him?

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: AB feels he’s recovered sufficiently from the shooting to return to work, but gradually realises he’s far from ready. Tim is fed up with the way Bridgette meddles in his relationship with Nicole, while Jerome has new hope that he can save his relationship with Carmen.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Lee-Ann struggles with tenants who refuse to renew their leases. Carmen is fired up to move in with Jerome. Tim finally speaks to Bridgette about him and Nicole.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Bridgette sinks the final nail into Tim and Nicole’s coffin. Fasie and Mathilda are making big plans, while Mrs J is yet again putting out fires around her.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Tim informs his father that Ian fired him. The treasure hunt to launch the opening of Carmen’s shop gets going. Meanwhile AB is back at work, but clearly suffering from post-traumatic stress.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Lee-Ann has a difficult decision to make regarding her relationship with Chris, while Ian tries to mend things with Tim. Mymoena struggles with a stubborn AB, and Bridgette’s tricks are catching up with her.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Nicole tries to mend her relationship with Tim. Mrs J starts to suspect that Chris and Lee-Ann are more than friends, while Jerome finds out about the secret in Carmen’s past. Meanwhile Rhafiek’s new girlfriend starts to doubt his feelings for her.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Chris and Lee-Ann struggle to suppress their feelings for one another, while Bianca and Derick’s love seems to blossom. Carmen invites the Octobers for supper at their new flat, and Bridgette can’t wait to criticise everything she sees.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: AB battles with sleeping problems. Bridgette and Ian fight over the children. Jerome is upset about his mom and Carmen, while Tim still doesn’t want to speak to Nicci.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Ian shares some important news with Bridgette and Mrs J. Tim tells his father that he applied for a job elsewhere, while Rhafiek ends his relationship with Shahieda. Someone returns home.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Tim has to decide whether he is going to stay in Cape Town or leave, while Bianca is confused by Derick’s strange behaviour. Stefan is nervous about asking Ian to invest in a restaurant and Chris struggles to keep his distance from Lee-Ann.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Tim packs his bags and sets off to Port Elizabeth. Nicole and Shahieda both have the blues, while Carmen teaches Jerome a lesson for having been so rude to her friend. Meanwhile Fasie is full of beans after the dance the previous evening but Mathilda isn’t feeling too bright...

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Tim and Nicole decide to keep their good news a secret for now. Lee-Ann and Chris try to avoid each other, while she and Ian forge a new understanding. AB’s therapy helps him realize something about his relationship with Mymoena.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Fasie struggles to contain his emotions when the time comes for Mathilda’s wake. Rhafiek wonders whether he should reveal his true feelings to Nicole, while Bridgette grows ever more suspicious of Ian and Lee-Ann’s new-found working relationship and tries desperately to keep him in her corner.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Fasie’s friends try to cheer him up. Derick has an attack and Nicole wants to tell her parents about her engagement. The police are looking for Derick, Fasie and AB.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: The pharmacy remains closed while the police conduct their investigation. Bridgette asks Nicole to move back home, while Jerome and Carmen make an important decision regarding their future. Is this the end?

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: AB and Mymoena try to speak to Fasie but in vain. Tim wonders why Ian summoned him, while Nicole moves back home again. Bianca is spooked when Derick swears he will revenge his mother’s death.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Bianca has to decide whether she will take her family’s side or Derick’s in the ongoing hostility between the parties since Mathilda’s death. Jerome resumes his wild ways after his breakup with Carmen, while Stefan is confident that his plans regarding the restaurant in Pretoria will work, but Ian is not convinced.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Bridgette and Ian attend a big annual charity function, while Bianca wants to make up with Derick. Michelle and Stefan’s night out doesn’t end so well.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: Stefan is in a tough situation and Bridgette has a huge surprise for Nicole. AB starts wondering whether he didn’t perhaps make a mistake with Mathilda’s medication, while Derick is adamant to avenge her death.

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: The Labarang festivities are under way. Stefan’s bail gets paid, but Michelle discovers something else. Nicole is hurt by Rhafiek’s attitude and AB’s holy day ends on a bad note.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Stefan has finally found a lawyer but they cannot afford his fees. Lee-Ann and Chris realise that they will have to make a plan to spend more time together. Meanwhile Bridgette has a prenuptual agreement drawn up for Nicole and Tim.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: Fasie gets to be an investigative journalist again. Chris and Lee-Anne’s relationship is tested, while Rhafiek gets an offer to make a huge commission. Bridgette feels neglected and Stefan is worried about his future.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: Fasie carries on with his detective work regarding Mathilda’s death, but how will Derick react to this? Stefan finds himself in an ever bigger pickle, while Chris and Lee-Ann try to give their relationship a shot in the arm. But then Tim voices his concern about Chris’s dedication to Rita...

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: Nicole loses her patience with Bridgette’s constant meddling in the wedding arrangements. Stefan realises he urgently needs money to handle the charge of drunk driving against him, while AB remains hopeful that Chris will dig up information implicating Mathilda’s domestic worker in her death, thereby absolving him of guilt.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: AB is convinced he knows who swapped Mathilda’s pills. Tim and Ian’s work relationship improves even more, much to Jerome’s irritation. Meanwhile Lee-Ann wants to find out what the true story is behind the shooting at the harbour.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: Fasie shares new information about Derick with AB, while Stefan reconsiders the offer from Michelle’s brother. Chris has good news for Lee-Ann and Bianca has to decide whether she’ll join Derick on his extended vacation.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: Nicole pranks Tim with the wedding invitations. Bianca has a confrontation with AB that makes him seriously reconsider his situation. Chris and Ian try to find out whether Supa Trans is busy with underhanded dealings.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: Bianca and Michelle both guard the secret of Derick having been alone in the pharmacy, while Ian is determined to run Cape2Gold as a clean business. videos.overview: AB has a difficult choice to make regarding Bridgette and Ismail’s affair. Mymoena finds it hard to believe Jerome is the right choice for Bianca, and Ian and Danielle get to know each other better.

videos.title: Episode 177
videos.overview: AB surprises Michelle with his plans for the future but she has other pressing matters to attend to. Bianca is unhappy about Jerome’s handling of his parents, and Mymoena decides to get involved with Ismail’s private affairs.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: AB and Rhafiek believe Mymoena will recover quickly, while Estelle tries to support Bianca, but her sorrow runs deep.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Nicole makes Mrs J realise her family needs her, while Bridgette’s drinking takes a turn for the worse. Siya struggles with his own growing guilt.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Ian visits Mymoena in hospital. Danielle and Justin go on their first date, but it doesn’t end the way she hoped it would.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The residents of Ruiterbosch say their goodbyes and Tim decides to be the better man, while Justin realises it’s now or never.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Nicole gives Lee-Anne something to think about, while Rhafiek’s loyalty lands him in trouble. Danielle is excited about Justin’s gig, but gets unexpected resistance.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Mrs J discovers Nicole plans on leaving and Ian discusses his brewing thoughts with Chris. Danielle and Justin are madly in love, while Bridgette feels more lost than ever.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Ian prepares to destroy Siya’s career, while Nicole finalises her plans to leave Ruiterbosch. Danielle finally plans a romantic evening with Justin, but it doesn’t go smoothly.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Nicole’s plans come as a shock to her parents, while Siya is tortured by Ian’s latest threats. Danielle proposes a game to aid her and Justin in getting on the same wavelength.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Ian confronts Siya in the shopping centre, while Michelle suspects the whole baby business is becoming too much for Bianca. AB finds out about Ian’s vendetta against Siya and decides to do something about it.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Siya is taken aback when the hospital’s director wants to see him. Carmen makes a decision about her life, while Danni is forced to own up about her and Tim.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: AB struggles with his medical aid, while feeling guilty about Siya’s predicament. Estelle takes her granddaughter on an outing and Bridgette gets emotional support from an unexpected source.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Ian disappears without a trace and everyone is concerned. Carmen gets a call from Jerome’s lawyer, while AB’s medical aid problems push him to a last desperate attempt.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Danni tries to negotiate her relationship with Justin, and a guest shows up at the Samsodien residence.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Rhiyaaz’s (played by Anton Jeftha) presence is celebrated, while Danielle is alone at home for once, and Tim spots an opportunity.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Lee-Ann surprises Carmen with an unexpected offer. AB and Estelle clash about Mymoena’s future and Bianca is faced with a difficult decision.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Bianca tells Michelle and Stefan that she might be going away. Rhiyaaz decides to stay in Ruiterbosch for a while longer.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Carmen moves in with the Du Plooys and Danni wonders if there is something brewing between her and Tim. Bianca is touched to see how much the people of Ruiterbosch love her and Stella, while AB has to decide how to take care of Mymoena.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: The Samsodiens’ joy after Mymoena’s awakening is short-lived. Bianca fears her decision to stay in Ruiterbosch will upset Estelle, while Bridgette learns that Lee-Ann and Mrs J want to get to know Carmen better.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Ian offers Carmen a job but Rhafiek and Stefan warn her against him. Bianca suspects her mom doesn’t trust her with Stella, and Rhafiek's twin brother Rhiyaaz (played by Anton Jeftha)* eventually visits Mymoena.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Bianca realises Estelle is hiding something big from her and Carmen. Rhafiek confronts Rhiyaaz about his conduct and habits.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Rhiyaaz finds it hard to keep hiding his secret lifestyle. Danielle has to decide whether she’s ready for the next step in her and Justin’s relationship.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Bianca finally loses patience with Michelle’s interfering and gives her a difficult ultimatum. Rhafiek realises Rhiyaaz needs boosters and becomes concerned about his erratic behaviour.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Michelle is urgently looking for Stefan when he doesn't return home the previous night. AB has good news to share with his family, but also an awkward favour to ask Estelle.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Mymoena finally returns home but Rhiyaaz spoils their first family dinner. Stefan unexpectedly bonds with Stella, while Danielle’s movie night bombs out.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Estelle and Mymoena meet for the first time, and AB is very worried that it might have a negative impact on his wife’s recovery. Justin has to make up for the impromptu party, while Rhiyaaz shocks his brother.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Mrs J wants to keep her family together, but it is easier said than done. The Samsodiens argue about the secret they should tell Mymoena.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Mymoena struggles with new information about her accident, while Rhiyaaz can’t hide his life choices from AB any longer. Danielle realises she has feelings for Tim.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: AB and Rhiyaaz have a big fallout, while Danielle needs to choose between Tim and Justin. Mrs J finds out that Mymoena is overwhelmed with guilt and decides to intervene.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Zoe’s presence is a constant thorn in Ian’s side, especially when Bridgette uses the situation to teach him a lesson. Tim tells Danielle how he feels about her but her reaction leaves him even more confused.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: AB feels guilty for having lost his temper with his sons. Bianca asks Carmen to take care of Stella during office hours, while Danielle is still upset after Tim kissed her.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Bianca feels pressurized and considers going back to work earlier than planned. Danni realises where her love actually lies.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Danielle realises she needs to tell Justin about her new romance with Tim before it can officially begin. Michelle has a confession, and Rhiyaaz gets a nasty surprise upon waking.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Mymoena fears that she won’t see Stella’s first big moments. Justins struggles with life after Danni, and Rhafiek tries to convince Rhiyaaz to speak to their parents.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Stefan tries to console Michelle after their bad news, but fails. Estelle annoys Mymoena, while AB tries to accept Rhiyaaz’s decisions, but can’t.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Rhiyaaz realises he doesn’t fit in anywhere, while Bianca gets a harsh pep talk from Carmen. Michelle is on an emotional rollercoaster and Bridgette becomes suspicious of Zoe’s motives.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Zoe has a fallout with the Octobers but then finds out where the fault really lies. Mymoena is tired of feeling useless and goes out shopping, but she runs into Ian.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Mymoena is upset because everyone is putting restrictions on her. Stefan wants to talk to Michelle about alternative options to have a baby, and Bridgette confronts Ian again about Zoe.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Peace returns to the Samsodien household, until Estelle shows up. The Octobers organise a braai but Ian’s attitude threatens to derail the festivities. Bianca is suddenly confronted with her past.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: The Samsodiens are worried about Rhiyaaz returning to London alone. Michelle gains new insight into her situation, and Carmen has a solution to Zoe’s sudden unemployment woes.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: Mymoena plans a surprise for the Samsodiens, while the Gerbers have their own family issues. Bianca is worried about her two mothers, and Justin suffers from writer’s block.

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: Estelle and Mymoena’s fighting reaches boiling point. Danielle is shaken by Justin’s song and Stefan attempts to have an important conversation with Michelle.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Mymoena tries to reconcile with Bianca, who has a difficult decision to make. Stefan and Michelle differ about surrogacy or adoption, while a furious Danielle confronts Justin after his radio interview.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: Mymoena and AB are still processing Bianca’s news. Bridgette is ready to take Carmen to task, and Michelle realises how much effort Stefan puts into helping her work through her trauma.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: Bianca is leaving for the farm and Mymoena is beside herself. Danni apologises to Justin but he’s only interested in his next gig.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: Both Justin and Carmen are chastised. The Gerbers are investigating baby options, while Ian outsmarts Bridgette.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: Mymoena asserts her independence, while Tim lashes out at Justin for allowing Danni to suffer under his fans. Ian’s takeover of Suidooster is put into gear, but he needs Bridgette and Tim’s help.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: Tim and Bridgette put Ian’s plan in motion to get Carmen on board for the lifestyle centre. The Gerbers realise surrogacy is going to be more difficult than they imagined, and Lee-Ann is on the war path again.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: Justin feels the pressure of having to write another hit and Carmen puts her foot down regarding the centre’s planned upgrade. Bianca receives a letter that could turn her life upside down.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: Justin is desperately looking for inspiration for his new song and surprises Tim with a strange request. Zoe makes an effort with Wayde but Bridgette comes between them. The Gerbers get a call from the clinic...

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: Bianca struggles to share her disturbing news with anyone, while Michelle and Stefan start looking for a surrogate. Zoe decides to give Wade another chance...

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: Ian finds it strange that Lee-Ann suddenly has a large sum of money to invest in the development. Justin comes to a shocking realisation about his new song, while AB’s reaction to Derrick’s demands surprises Bianca.

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: The Gerbers receive good news regarding a potential surrogate, but the Octobers get bad news about the plans for the centre. AB is bent on helping Bianca with Derick, as Siya is with Kim.

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: Lee-Ann struggles to accept that Ian wil be involved in the lifestyle centre. Mymoena fears that Bianca is ignoring the Derick issue, and the Gerbers prepare to meet their surrogate mother.

videos.title: Episode 54
videos.overview: AB finds out about the plans for Suidooster Centre and is livid, while Bianca prepares for the paternity test. Siya does his best to help Kim (played by Tarryn Lamb), but does she want his help?

videos.title: Episode 55
videos.overview: Ian and Bridgette try to convince Mrs J to sign the contract for the development of the centre. Wade runs into bad luck and has to cancel his date with Zoe or make another plan. Kim invites Siya for coffee…

videos.title: Episode 56
videos.overview: AB is still struggling to get answers from Bianca and Mymoena. The Gerbers receive the results of the surrogate mother’s evaluation, and chaos reigns at Suidooster Properties while the team struggle to make their deadline.

videos.title: Episode 57
videos.overview: Lee-Ann makes a shocking discovery when she attempts to transfer money from the business trust account. Tim offers to help Danielle out of her predicament with Justin’s band and Bridgette is determined to make the best of a bad situation.

videos.title: Episode 58
videos.overview: Lee-Ann makes a shocking discovery and realises she needs help. The Gerbers make a decision regarding their surrogate and Bianca gets the results of the paternity test.

videos.title: Episode 59
videos.overview: Lee-Ann has information to ruin Ian, but is forced to consider the safety of her family. Bianca struggles with her secret, while Siya learns more about Kim’s past.

videos.title: Episode 60
videos.overview: Rhafiek asks Siya about Kim and AB wants Bianca to tell Stefan that Stella is his daughter. Wade puts Zoe in an uncomfortable position, while Ian tries to get on Lee-Ann’s good side.

videos.title: Episode 61
videos.overview: Ruiterbosch is abuzz with the news of Ian’s arrest. Bianca doesn’t want to tell Stefan anything, but AB gives her an ultimatum. Siya tries to forget about Kim, but she has other ideas.

videos.title: Episode 62
videos.overview: Bianca tries to make time to speak to Stefan about Stella but gets an unpleasant surprise. Mrs J asks Chris to go to Ian’s bail hearing, and Lee-Ann gets a lot of opposition after his arrest.

videos.title: Episode 63
videos.overview: Chris visits Ian in jail and Ian uses the opportunity to ask him for a favour. Kim tells Vernon that she wants to visit her mother in Boksburg and Michelle offers Natasha a job at Oos Wes.

videos.title: Episode 64
videos.overview: Kim and Siya plan to flee Cape Town, and Zoe is beside herself when she hears that Wade was attacked on his way home. Lee-Ann moves into Ian’s office, while Tim is not pleased with this latest development.

videos.title: Episode 65
videos.overview: Siya and Kim are in a precarious situation with a fatally wounded Vernon. Bridgette has another humiliating experience and the Gerbers go to court to hear if Natasha can still be their surrogate.

videos.title: Episode 66
videos.overview: Bianca has a difficult time keeping her secret from Stefan, while the Octobers make plans to secure their wealth. Rhafiek forces Siya to question Kim’s motives.

videos.title: Episode 67
videos.overview: Siya is in trouble with the law and Wade’s pride irritates Zoe. Natasha is looking for a place to stay, while Bridgette has to tell Ian that she couldn’t sell their valuables.

videos.title: Episode 68
videos.overview: The truth about Vernon’s death is finally revealed. Ian tries to make sense of the attack on him in prison and Wade is convinced he and Zoe will never work as a couple.

videos.title: Episode 70
videos.overview: Siya and Natasha need to make a difficult decision: whether to go to the police or not. Wade and Zoe have another disagreement but then they share surprising information with each other.

videos.title: Episode 71
videos.overview: Michelle tries to support Bianca but ends up making her even more anxious. Kim invites Rhafiek to dinner but he rejects the invitation and Bridgette tries to borrow money from Mrs J.

videos.title: Episode 72
videos.overview: Zoe confronts Bridgette about her attitude towards Wade but Bridgette has bigger fish to fry. Kim makes a decision about her future, while Stefan contemplates his.

videos.title: Episode 73
videos.overview: Stefan tries to get a DNA sample of Stella but it’s a challenge with Bianca and Mymoena guarding the little one permanently. Bridgette insists Ian must take the protection money, but they get other instructions.

videos.title: Episode 74
videos.overview: Ian finds out that the protection money did not reach the right people. Tim and Lee-Ann are at loggerheads over Ian again, and Stefan waits anxiously for the DNA results, but something else is also starting to bother him.

videos.title: Episode 75
videos.overview: Lee-Ann believes Suidooster Properties made a big impact at the Women’s Day lunch. Danni is worried about Ian’s influence over Tim, and Zoe stresses about the bad news she has to give Wade.

videos.title: Episode 76
videos.overview: Zoe has one foot on the cruise ship, but Wade tries to stop her. Ian finds out who Plakkies really is, while Stefan finally learns the truth about baby Stella.

videos.title: Episode 77
videos.overview: Stefan confronts Bianca about Stella, while Plakkies puts increasing pressure on Ian to smuggle his parcel out of the country. Bridgette starts falling apart.

videos.title: Episode 78
videos.overview: Stefan tries to stay out of Bianca’s way and gets advice from Chris. The new neighbour asks a favour from Mrs J, while Bridgette visits Ian with important news.

videos.title: Episode 79
videos.overview: Ian must see Bridgette again and asks Tim to help him. Bianca realises she can never let Michelle discover the truth about Stella.

videos.title: Episode 80
videos.overview: Bridgette gets a nasty surprise, while Stefan makes a decision about the IVF. Mrs J’s new neighbour is still creating havoc and Carmen discovers Bianca’s secret.

videos.title: Episode 81
videos.overview: Mrs J reaches out to Tyron and Ian uses Tim to assist with his plan. Meanwhile, Michelle and Stefan try to support Natasha, while Lee-Ann is suspicious of Bridgette’s new venture.

videos.title: Episode 82
videos.overview: Bridgette is worried about what Lee-Ann will do now that she knows about Ian’s latest plan. Natasha’s jealousy makes her desperate for attention, while Mrs J wants Tyron to apologise to Wade.

videos.title: Episode 83
videos.overview: Bridgette follows instructions regarding Ian’s plan with the diamonds, but will it work? Natasha organises alone time for her and Stefan, while Carmen and Bianca have their biggest fight yet.

videos.title: Episode 84
videos.overview: Everyone is panicking about Bridgette’s arrest but things are not what they seem. Stefan tells Michelle about Natasha’s attempt to kiss him, while Mymoena tries to reconcile Bianca and Carmen.

videos.title: Episode 85
videos.overview: Ian is back at the office and Bridgette makes an important decision. Natasha hears that Stefan visited Bianca on the sly and uses that to mess with Michelle’s head.

videos.title: Episode 86
videos.overview: Stefan and Michelle decide to take Natasha to task abour her lying. Ian wants to know from AB and Mymoena where his wife is, while Zoe is uncomfortable with the friendship developing between Wade and Tyron.

videos.title: Episode 87
videos.overview: Natasha and the Gerbers find out if the IVF treatment worked. Ian and Lee-Ann argue about Tim, while Tyron invites Wade for darts, but without Zoe.

videos.title: Episode 88
videos.overview: Stefan wants to tell Michelle his secret, but something crops up again. Mrs J tries to make peace between Zoe and Tyron. Bianca’s worst nightmare comes true when something happens to Stella.

videos.title: Episode 89
videos.overview: As the search for Stella continues everyone wonders who took her and for what reason. Tim is not happy about the status quo at Suidooster Properties but Ian puts him at ease.

videos.title: Episode 90
videos.overview: Everyone in Ruiterbosch works together to find Natasha and Stella. Ian lures Zoe and her friends to the October home for a braai - with a hidden agenda.

videos.title: Episode 91
videos.overview: Michelle confronts Bianca and her family. Tyron (played by Maurice Paige) finds out more about Wade’s past and suspects that there is a connection between them. Lee-Ann unexpectedly meets an interesting man.

videos.title: Episode 92
videos.overview: Natasha makes sure that Stefan and Michelle are no longer together. Lee-Ann wonders if she should call Adam, while Bianca and her family are frantic about Stella.

videos.title: Episode 93
videos.overview: Michelle realises the level of Natasha’s insanity when she shares her plans. Mrs J tries her best not to interfere with Lee-Ann’s love life, while Wade and Tyron make a shocking discovery.

videos.title: Episode 94
videos.overview: Wade and Tyron have a lot to process, while the Samsodiens and Gerbers try to recover from Stella’s kidnapping. Lee-Ann discovers something about Adam that influences their chance of a relationship.

videos.title: Episode 95
videos.overview: Michelle and Stefan must make a decision about their marriage, while Lee-Ann begins a new relationship. Justin has problems with his car and Tim irks Ian when he stands up for Danielle.

videos.title: Episode 96
videos.overview: Bridgette puts her foot down and catches Ian unawares. After moving in with Tyron, Wade starts having doubts. Stefan is down in the dumps because Michelle wants nothing to do with him.

videos.title: Episode 97
videos.overview: Tyron and Wade enjoy living together, while AB receives upsetting news. Bridgette proves to Ian she’s serious about the divorce and Lee-Ann makes a decision about her future with Adam.

videos.title: Episode 98
videos.overview: Justin pushes Tyron for a poker evening but first they have to get rid of Wade. Mrs J and Bridgette meet Adam, while Rhafiek gives Stefan an earful.

videos.title: Episode 99
videos.overview: Popeye invites Justin to a special poker evening. Bridgette receives a summons and Ian calls Chris for a meeting.

videos.title: Episode 100
videos.overview: Adam meets Chris and immediately suspects he may have competition, while Bridgette makes it clear to Ian that she won’t settle without a fight. Justin gets roped into another game of poker...

videos.title: Episode 101
videos.overview: Bridgette takes revenge on Ian, while Chris tries to find out more about Lee-Ann’s new relationship. Adam gets annoyed with Bridgette and Michelle misreads Siya’s caring affection.

videos.title: Episode 102
videos.overview: Justin makes a plan to pay Popeye, while Stefan and Bianca keep arguing about Stella. Ian discovers that Adam does actually have a secret, and Siya gives Michelle some new insight.

videos.title: Episode 103
videos.overview: Ian believes his marriage has been saved, but Bridgette has other ideas. Wade blames Tyron for Justin’s troubles, and Michelle tries to reach out to Stefan.

videos.title: Episode 104
videos.overview: Justin runs out of time to get Popeye’s money and he becomes desperate. Ian and Adam have a confrontation, while Stefan is back home, assuming everything will be back to normal again.

videos.title: Episode 105
videos.overview: News of the burglary at Oos Wes spreads through Ruiterbosch. Tyron convinces Justin to lie to the police about the identity of the thief and Bridgette makes a final decision about her marriage.

videos.title: Episode 106
videos.overview: Justin is very worried about Tim, while Tyron fears that Justin may let something slip. Mrs J is concerned about how quickly Lee-Ann is falling for Adam, and Bridgette makes a decision about her future.

videos.title: Episode 107
videos.overview: Ian makes a last desperate attempt to sway Bridgette. Siya is uncomfortable with Michelle and Lee-Ann is shocked to discover who Suidooster Properties lost the contract to.

videos.title: Episode 108
videos.overview: Bridgette and Ian reconcile, but not everyone is celebrating. Michelle is uncertain about her future with Stefan, while Lee-Ann gives up on her relationship with Adam.

videos.title: Episode 109
videos.overview: Lee-Ann invites Bridgette and Mrs J to dinner to break the news about her and Adam’s plans. Tim feels caged in at home and Michelle learns that Stefan wants to keep Stella away from her.

videos.title: Episode 110
videos.overview: Tim is furious when he hears Ian appointed a new architect behind his back. Lee-Ann is excited about her and Adam’s plans, but Mrs J is not quite as sure.

videos.title: Episode 111
videos.overview: Danielle becomes increasingly concerned about Tim, while Stefan tries his best to work on his relationship with Michelle. Bridgette feels ignored by Lee-Ann and Adam comes up with a good suggestion.

videos.title: Episode 112
videos.overview: Mrs J and Carmen team up for a special occasion but Mrs J can’t keep up with everything. Michelle learns that Bianca was planning to quit her job at Oos Wes, while Danielle tries to convince Tim to go for tests.

videos.title: Episode 113
videos.overview: Michelle reaches out to Bianca and Stefan is hopeful for the future. Ian gives Lee-Ann and the rest of his staff an ultimatum. Chris and Danni are more optimistic about Tim’s health.

videos.title: Episode 114
videos.overview: Stefan lies to Bianca about Michelle and Stella. Lee-Ann makes a big announcement.

videos.title: Episode 115
videos.overview: Tim’s frustration with his drawings leads to conflict at work and at home. Stefan and Bianca receive shocking news about Stella.

videos.title: Episode 116
videos.overview: Ruiterbosch gets ready to celebrate. Bridgette sends Tyron and Wade a surprise, while Chris pays Lee-Ann a final visit.

videos.title: Episode 117
videos.overview: Chris tests his theory about Adam and Ian, while Bianca wants to put Stella in an expensive daycare. Tim struggles to adapt to his new duties and takes it out on Danielle.

videos.title: Episode 118
videos.overview: Stefan and Bianca argue about Stella again, while Danielle confronts Tim about his moods. Chris makes a plan to find out more about Adam but Ian hears about it.

videos.title: Episode 119
videos.overview: Lee-Ann and Adam are back from a romantic getaway and discover that Chris was in their flat. Tim sees Danielle and Justin hugging in Oos Wes, while Bianca forces Rhafiek to call an ex-girlfriend of his.

videos.title: Episode 120
videos.overview: Rhafiek surprises his family with an unexpected request. Tim causes trouble at the office and Lee-Ann picks up the last of her stuff at Mrs J’s house.

videos.title: Episode 121
videos.overview: Ian and Lee-Ann are still locking horns, but Adam has a solution. Stefan breaks a promise and Michelle overreacts completely, while Tim spirals further downwards.

videos.title: Episode 122
videos.overview: Lee-Ann makes a decision about her future at Suidooster Properties, but upsets the Octobers in the process. Tim pushes Danielle away, while the Samsodiens butt heads about the right wife for Rhafiek.

videos.title: Episode 123
videos.overview: Lee-Ann’s offer to Carmen and Rhafiek threatens to tear her family apart again. Stefan looks forward to family time, but Michelle has other plans.

videos.title: Episode 124
videos.overview: Lee-Ann catches Ian unawares when she shows up at his office. Rhafiek has his first meeting with the girl AB chose for him, and Tim gets completely out of hand.

videos.title: Episode 125
videos.overview: Bridgette wants Danielle to press criminal charges against Tim. Adam plants a spy camera in his flat and Justin wants to tell Tim the truth about the robbery at Oos Wes.

videos.title: Episode 126
videos.overview: Michelle tries her best to keep her and Stefan’s relationship on an even keel. Chris comes to a shocking realisation and rushes to Lee-­Ann’s aid.

videos.title: Episode 127
videos.overview: Adam’s actions create pandemonium. Rhafiek is going to meet another prospective bride, while Stefan’s enthusiasm over Stella is getting to Michelle.

videos.title: Episode 128
videos.overview: Stefan begs Michelle to give him one more chance, while Tim struggles to tell Chris about his problems. Lee-Ann realises the full extent of Adam’s damage.

videos.title: Episode 129
videos.overview: Ian proposes a way to save Suidooster, but Lee-Ann won’t hear of it. Rhafiek wants to marry Nuraan, but AB has a mishap with her father.

videos.title: Episode 130
videos.overview: Rhafiek finds out about Mister Jaffer’s issues with Mymoena and Bianca. Michelle rejects Bianca’s friendship and Tim is not happy with his psychologist’s advice.

videos.title: Episode 131
videos.overview: The shareholders in the centre sign the merger contract while Lee-Ann blames herself for what happened. Tim experiences a setback after starting art therapy and Mr Jaffer visits the Samsodiens.

videos.title: Episode 132
videos.overview: Tim decides to give art therapy a chance and Mymoena gets a visit from Nuraan, which makes her rethink the situation. Bridgette calls on Mrs J to try and save Lee-Ann from herself.

videos.title: Episode 133
videos.overview: The brothers’ cooking lesson go more smoothly than the previous one, but Mrs J doesn’t feel well. Mymoena promises not to go overboard with Rhafiek and Nuraan’s first date, while Tim is worried about money

videos.title: Episode 134
videos.overview: Bridgette and Ian’s plans with the centre cause friction in the Jacobs family. Danielle is worried when she learns something about Tim, while there is an incident at Fasie’s house.

videos.title: Episode 135
videos.overview: Carmen and Rhafiek are at each other’s throats over the Camp’s Bay house. Danielle and Tim try their best to rekindle their love, while Mrs J can’t seem to shake her illness.

videos.title: Episode 136
videos.overview: Tim swallows his pride to earn an income, while Wade feels bad about him and Tyron squatting at Siya’s place. Lee-Ann reassesses her future as part of the new Suidooster Properties.

videos.title: Episode 137
videos.overview: Lee-Ann gets a new lease on life, while Mrs J’s flu worsens. Rhafiek and Carmen are at each other’s throats and Kamaal puts pressure on Rhafiek.

videos.title: Episode 138
videos.overview: Danielle is worried because Tim hasn’t painted again. Rhafiek and Carmen get into another argument after a disastrous meeting with a potential client and Lee-Ann returns to work.

videos.title: Episode 139
videos.overview: Siya is concerned about Mrs J’s health and Rhafiek pulls a prank on Carmen. Wade is surprised to hear that Tyron called in the professionals, while someone wants to buy Tim’s painting.

videos.title: Episode 140
videos.overview: Siya finds out about Tyron’s scheme and makes an appointment for Mrs J with a specialist. Rhafiek and Carmen’s game is almost discovered by Ian, while Rhafiek and Nuraan struggle to connect.

videos.title: Episode 141
videos.overview: Rhafiek and Carmen tackle their project, but will Ian be impressed with the results? Mymoena starts making plans with Nuraan, while Siya is worried about Mrs J’s reaction to her diagnosis.

videos.title: Episode 142
videos.overview: Mrs J tries to hide her illness, while Bridgette finds out Danielle lied about the painting. Rhafiek and Carmen launch one last effort to sell the house in Camps Bay.

videos.title: Episode 143
